note: City of Lake View campground on the north shore of Black Hawk Lake, beside the town beach; the shore row of back-in sites faces the water across a strip of grass and riprap. Four local boat ramps, mini golf, and the Sauk Rail Trail nearby. --Claude
summary: Fees added (none before): $23-27 from the park's own booking engine for June 2027 (30-amp W/E $23, 50-amp W/E or 30-amp full hookup $25, 50-amp full hookup $27). Sites -> 167 (74 full hookup + 93 W/E), pull-throughs; season closes 10-01 -> 10-31 (limited service in October, closes Nov 1); booking platform operator (reservationfriend). Lakefront confirmed: the shore row of back-in pads ends ~6-10 m from the water across grass and riprap, with no road, driveway or day use between. Pin inside the campground (fine).
